scope: Source-code verification of ghfind and transferable evaluation/statistics designs; not an exhaustive literature corpus or validation of OpenCost difficulty scoring.

reviewedFiles.supports: Log saturation, missing-value behavior, caps, separate own/external contribution and acceptance semantics, newcomer bottleneck formula, deterministic six-dimension score.
Exact dimension weights and current five presentation tiers; reputation tiers must not be reused for task difficulty.
Smoothed rate and Wilson lower bound; observed evidence, coverage, sample-size and corroboration gates; note-only public footprint; family caps; confidence is an engineered coverage score.
Versioned numeric rules: 25 total risk cap, 16 contribution, 9 social, 20 minimum samples, 40 full sample, Wilson z=1.96.
Immutable snapshot hash/version validation, replacing untrusted embedded score with deterministic recomputation and preserving provenance.
Current web route freezes score delta at zero; README description of bounded LLM calibration is not current code behavior in this route.
Evidence IDs must exist; analysis, repository, commit and schema must match; dimension sum must equal product score.
Historical 2026-07-13 explanation; some penalty and tier text differs from current pinned implementation.

caveats: Heuristic account-public-footprint score; not scientific validation of AI task difficulty.
The separately published spamBotScore is not identical to current public risk v10.
Snapshot hashes establish byte consistency, not truth of the source events.

reviewedFiles.supports: Scored, errored and unscored outcomes have distinct denominator and coverage semantics.
Metric aggregation is separate from scoring individual samples.
Clustered standard error, t/bootstrap intervals, Wilson interval, resampling whole clusters.

caveats: Some numeric helpers return zero standard error or point intervals for insufficient observations; OpenCost should represent insufficient uncertainty estimation explicitly.
Cluster semantics must be defined for contributor/root task/batch rather than treating nested agents as independent samples.

reviewedFiles.supports: Mergeable sufficient statistics, optional missing values, population variance definition.
Observed, denoised and idealized runtime kept separate, batch size retained, unavailable model estimates remain unknown.

caveats: Population variance is not the standard error of a community estimate.
Idealized runtime and observed deployment time have different interpretations and must not be conflated.

reviewedFiles.supports: Require evidence tests ran and cross-check exit status; separate requirement resolution (F2P) and regression preservation (P2P); complete/partial/no resolution.

caveats: Empty-test denominator returns one in this benchmark code; it must not become evidence of full verification in OpenCost.
Code-test metrics are not sufficient for writing, image, advisory or other task domains.
